placements.note: The design paper says the 50 kg array 'will be deployed in a 1725 m3 tank filled with LN2 ... situated at Hall C1 as part of the extension project of CJPL (CJPL-II)'.
placements.quote: This tank is situated at Hall C1 as part of the extension project of CJPL (CJPL-II) [17].

summary.plain: CDEX-50 is a proposed next stage of the CDEX programme: 50 kilograms of germanium detectors bathed in liquid nitrogen in the expanded Jinping underground laboratory in China, aimed at very light dark matter.
summary.technical: Next-generation CDEX project with a 50 kg germanium detector array in a 1725 m^3 liquid-nitrogen tank at Hall C1 of CJPL-II. Projected spin-independent sensitivity 5.1e-45 cm^2 at 5 GeV/c^2 for a 150 kg yr exposure and a 160 eVee threshold; expected background ~0.01 counts/keVee/kg/day in 2-2.5 keVee.
